description: Precomputed use-case matching. A host application asks the user to describe a use case, tokenizes it, sums the term weights from `index`, and returns the top agents — entirely client-side, with no backend and no GitHub access.

how_to_query.canonical: Look up a use_cases[].id for a curated, ranked list.
how_to_query.free_text: Lowercase the query, split on non-alphanumerics, drop tokens of 2 characters or fewer, then for each token read index[token] (entries are 'agent_id:weight'). Sum weights per agent_id and sort descending.
